summary: Brother of Maria Antonia DiBiasi; John's 3rd great-granduncle.
bio: b. 28 Sep 1856 Guardia Lombardi; d. 8 Feb 1922 Scranton; buried in Dunmore. Married Victoria DiPietro; son John N. (1892-1974) had a son Nicholas (1919-2002).
